_comment: The same two disallowed libraries banned-library declares, and neither one ships. The published file listing for each answers, and nothing in the XPI came from either release, so the add-on is not carrying them and the audit is not made: no finding, no early exit, and the Standard Manual Review section is present and asked. That is the whole point of the fixture - the policy blocklist is matched locally, with no request to skip, so without the shipping gate both would be reported here as bundled. Its sibling banned-library pins the other half: there the listing cannot be read, so the question stays open and the audit IS made.
